products.title: PRESALE: THE FERMENTATION PROJECT
products.body_html:
A GLOBAL SPECIALTY COFFEE TASTING BY JAMES HOFFMANN & LUCIA SOLIS

This listing is for a pre-order of The Fermentation Project, which will be roasted on September 14th and shipped out via UPS Ground September 16th-18th, arriving before the virtual tasting event on October 3rd at 9:00 AM CST (3:00 PM UK).

What happens when everything stays the same, except the way a coffee is processed? This project was created as an educational exploration of fermentation with Lucia Solis, a microbiologist and winemaker whose work focuses on using fermentation to develop flavor. Working alongside producers around the world, Lucia has helped redefine the way we think about fermentation, not as a shortcut to intensity, but as one of many creative decisions that shape a coffee’s final expression.

For this experiment, one coffee was processed four different ways using controlled fermentation methods. The farm, harvest, variety, altitude, and roast profile remain consistent, allowing one key question to take center stage:

How does fermentation influence what we experience in the cup?

At Stone Creek, we believe curiosity grows through experience. Instead of simply explaining fermentation, we wanted to invite you to taste it firsthand. Compare each process side by side, notice the differences, and discover how a single decision can transform the character of a coffee.

Why are we geeking out about this? Watch James Hoffmann talk about this project here.

Exclusively available online for an extremely limited time.

products.title: ROY G BIV COLD BREW FILTER PACKS
products.body_html:
MESS-FREE COLD BREW

Brewing cold brew has never been easier! Our Roy G Biv Cold Brew Filter Packs are pre-filled with our Roy G Biv coffee, perfectly ground for cold brewing. Simply steep in water, let it brew, and enjoy cold brew with zero mess. Available in a two-pack for a quick treat or a ten-pack to keep the refreshing goodness flowing. Whether you're a casual sipper or a cold brew enthusiast, this hassle-free option delivers cafe-quality flavor without the fuss. Just steep, sip, and savor!

products.title: FREAK FINDER KIT
products.body_html:
EXPLORE THE WHOLE SPECTRUM

This is your caffeine calibration lab. Inside are five blends, each dialed to a specific percentage of caffeine relative to a standard bag of coffee. Your options range from basically zero caffeine to full throttle. Brew them side by side, spread them out across your week, or share with a fellow freak. Each coffee is roasted to taste great, no matter the buzz level. You don’t have to guess what works for you. Taste it. Feel it. Know it.

Each kit contains five 12 oz bags. Save $30 versus buying the individual bags!

products.title: VANILLA FLOAT DECAF COLOMBIA
products.body_html:
DECAFFEINATED AT THE SOURCE

Most decaf coffee travels halfway around the world before the caffeine is removed. This fresh-crop Colombia takes a different path. After milling in Popayán, it's decaffeinated nearby at Descafecol in Manizales, the only major decaffeination facility in South America. Using a natural sugarcane decaffeination and fresh water from a volcano, caffeine gets removed gently while preserving the coffee's natural sweetness and character, reducing the carbon footprint of moving coffee across continents for processing.

Sourced through our import partner, Cofinet, this lot comes from 75 smallholder farmers who received up to a 20% quality premium for exceptional coffee. We're roasting it light to preserve the high-elevation brightness and sweetness that the sugarcane process enhances, bringing forward notes of caramel, vanilla, and malt. With fresh arrivals landing in June and again in early August, this offering stays remarkably fresh from beginning to end.

Available for a limited time.
